title: ultrasearch profile
description: Schema for ultrasearch v2 profile YAML files (profiles/<name>.yaml). Each profile names a set of source clients, a scoring function, and an output template. Validation is performed at load time by scripts/_profile.py.

name.description: Profile identifier. Must match the YAML filename stem (e.g. 'dev' for profiles/dev.yaml).

description.description: Trigger description used by the classifier subagent. One sentence.

sources.description: Ordered list of source clients this profile invokes. Each entry refers to a module in scripts/sources/<id>.py.

weight.description: Relative weight for cross-source ranking. Profile weights need not sum to 1.0 — normalization happens at ranking time.

config.description: Free-form per-source configuration passed through to the source client. Schema is owned by each source module.

scoring.description: Scoring function reference in the form '<path/to/file.py>:<funcname>' — resolved relative to skill_dir().

output_template.description: Default Jinja2 template filename (relative to templates/) used by synthesize_v2.py.

output_alt.description: Alternative template filenames the classifier may pick instead of output_template (e.g. ['adr.md.j2']).

deps.description: List of pip package names this profile lazy-installs via ensure_env.py. Empty means the profile uses only the base v1 dependencies.

recursive_capable.description: Whether the profile can be run under --recursive (branching orchestrator).

flat_defaults.description: Default flag values when this profile runs in flat (non-recursive) mode.

recursive_defaults.description: Default flag values when this profile runs in recursive mode. Ignored if recursive_capable is false.
